note: Only geometry is used. Textures, materials and source files are never bundled; the model is decimated, normalised and quantised by tools/prepare-assets.py into src/assets/<name>.geo, which the single-file build embeds. The car was sourced on Sketchfab; Adam Pollock confirmed on 27 September 2026 that it allows public and commercial use. The Timber Frame House and Korean Bakery models supplied earlier are no longer used: at ten metres a dense timber frame and a shop interior did not read as a house and a bakery, so both are now drawn procedurally in the same hand as the rest of the sculpture. Their files are not bundled and no attribution is required.
